cmds: scoreboard objectives add demo_tick dummy "全局时钟"
scoreboard objectives add demo_ready dummy "已建档"
scoreboard objectives add demo_hp dummy "血量镜像"
scoreboard objectives add demo_cd dummy "冷却"
scoreboard objectives add demo_fire dummy "触发标记"
scoreboard objectives add demo_burst dummy "连发余量"
scoreboard objectives add demo_cap dummy "弹匣容量"
scoreboard objectives add demo_dmg dummy "单发伤害"
scoreboard objectives add demo_bullet dummy "子弹标记"
scoreboard objectives add demo_recoil dummy "弹道射程"
gamerule commandblockoutput false
gamerule sendcommandfeedback false
gamerule showcoordinates true
tickingarea add ~-2 ~-2 ~-2 ~66 ~6 ~66 demo true
tellraw @a {"rawtext":[{"text":"§b▸ 试作型系统已加载"}]}
scoreboard players add @a demo_tick 1
scoreboard players remove @a demo_cd 1
scoreboard players operation @a demo_cd > sys_zero sys
execute as @a run scoreboard players operation @s demo_hp = @s health
execute as @a run scoreboard players operation @s demo_hp *= sys_five tmp
execute as @a if entity @s[scores={demo_ready=0..}] run scoreboard players set @s demo_ready 1
execute as @a unless score @s demo_ready matches 0.. run scoreboard players set @s demo_ready 0
{RESET}
execute as @a[hasitem={item=fishing_rod,location=slot.weapon.mainhand}] run scoreboard players set @s demo_cap 8
execute as @a[hasitem={item=fishing_rod,location=slot.weapon.mainhand}] run scoreboard players set @s demo_dmg 6
{RESET}
execute as @e[type=fishing_hook] at @s run scoreboard players set @s demo_burst 3
execute as @e[type=fishing_hook] at @s run scoreboard players set @s demo_fire 1
kill @e[type=fishing_hook]
{RESET}
execute as @a[scores={demo_fire=1}] at @s unless score @s demo_cd matches 1.. run summon xp_orb ^^^1.45 facing ^^^1000
execute as @a[scores={demo_fire=1}] at @s unless score @s demo_cd matches 1.. run particle minecraft:basic_flame_particle ~ ~1 ~
execute as @a[scores={demo_fire=1}] at @s unless score @s demo_cd matches 1.. run playsound random.explode @a[r=48] ~~~ 1.0 0.55 100
execute as @a[scores={demo_fire=1}] at @s unless score @s demo_cd matches 1.. run playsound mob.ghast.fireball @a[r=32] ~~~ 0.85 0.85

execute as @a[scores={demo_fire=1}] at @s unless score @s demo_cd matches 1.. run scoreboard players remove @s demo_burst 1
execute as @a[scores={demo_fire=1}] at @s unless score @s demo_cd matches 1.. run scoreboard players set @s demo_cd 6
execute as @a[scores={demo_burst=..0}] run scoreboard players set @s demo_fire 0
